content.comment_body: I'm unsure which date parameter type is appropriate for use with [product_name] Web Editor. I want to input a date parameter in an MMDD format into [product_name] memory. ...sent from App
Why do you want to input day and month using [product_name] Web Editor? What is the intended use for this data in the [product_name] program? Please provide additional details.

Thanks for your response. I'm using a yearly timer function, and when it reaches a specific month and date, it triggers an output to perform a certain action. It's essentially a calendar timer. I need to adjust the month and date using [product_name] Web Editor. I’m not sure how to create and input this parameter in [product_name] Web Editor. Can you advise? For the time input, the format was specified as HEX for HH:MM based on previous advice. But for MM:DD, does this also need to be in HEX format or not?
For yearly timer functionality, the input fields for day, month, and year should also use HEX format in [product_name] Web Editor.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to input specific date parameters in an MMDD format into [product_name] memory via [product_name] Web Editor. There is uncertainty about whether the date (month-day) input must be in HEX format, similar to time (hour-minute) parameters. The discussion highlights confusion due to unclear guidance in [product_name] Web Editor documentation or interface regarding valid date parameter formats.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to easily input and adjust date parameters (MMDD) via the [product_name] Web Editor, with clear instructions on the required format.
